kpi2.selected_method: Frozen random forest with cumulative-maximum correction
kpi2.selection_reason: Eliminates scenario-order inconsistencies with negligible validation MAE increase

kpi3.selected_method: Corrected predicted shortage multiplied by nonnegative unit-cost premium
kpi3.selection_reason: Lower validation MAE and nondecreasing predictions for fixed premium

limitations: Targets are synthetic simulator outputs, not observed operational outcomes.
The chained KPI3 method reflects the simulator's shortage-times-premium cost structure.
Historical availability of emergency replacement prices is an assumption, not independently timestamp-verified.
Validation selection does not establish performance on unseen real-world procurement data.
No causal interpretation or automatic procurement decision is authorized.
